2.uniqueName.disclosure: Move hidden messages back to the main chat?. 1 hidden message(s) held only by "Trade" will return to the main chat in their original order. No visible message will be pruned.

3.refusals.unconfirmedReason: deleting "Trade" would leave hidden messages with no tab; that needs the confirmation that moves them back to the main chat (nothing was changed). You can keep, disable or move the tab instead.
